comment: None of the 32 inputs or the output is named in configInput or configOutput, so Rack's tooltips are blank on all of them. scales[] holds 43 rows but scaleNames[] is written with a missing comma between "UKRAINIAN DORIAN" and "TURKISH" (src/ScaleMerger.cpp:64), so the two run together as one name and the array supplies only 42 of its 43 entries: the 42nd scale shows as UKRAINIAN DORIANTURKISH and the 43rd, the top of the SCALE knob, has a null name that the display's sprintf prints as (null). Quantising compares the fractional part of the input against each pitch's fractional position as integers scaled by 10000 (normalize(), line 209), with no wrap, so the distance from a pitch near the top of the octave to C is measured the long way round and the result never rounds up into the next octave. probs2 is computed twice, once through getProb and once by a direct expression at line 384, which gives the same answer. The unique-pitch PROBABILITY knobs multiply only pitches that one scale has and the other does not; shared pitches are never scaled. The per-channel loop at line 413 returns from process() rather than continuing when a channel has no trigger, so later channels are not written that sample; their jack voltages persist, which is the intended result anyway.
